prior_art.basis: Independent review by claude-independent-prior-art-reviewer-20261106: No room-temperature ambient-pressure superconductor exists, so the Main KPI of 1 working superconductor is unmet. The 2023 LK-99 claim was refuted: replications found no superconductivity and the reported anomalies were explained without it (https://doi.org/10.1038/d41586-023-02585-7, https://doi.org/10.1088/1361-6668/ad2b78). The verified ambient-pressure records remain far below room temperature: cuprates about 133 K, bulk hole-doped SmNiO2 near 40 K (Nature 2025, https://doi.org/10.1038/s41586-025-08893-4) and strained (La,Pr)3Ni2O7 films with onset near 63 K and zero resistance near 37 K (National Science Review 2026, https://doi.org/10.1093/nsr/nwag151). Near-room-temperature hydrides need megabar pressures, and the 2025 to 2026 ambient room-temperature claims in Crossref are theoretical predictions and preprints, not measurements (https://api.crossref.org/works?query=room-temperature%20superconductivity%20ambient%20pressure%202026&rows=8&select=DOI,title,issued). Open machine-learning Tc predictors on GitHub are small student projects. Class neutral: a fundamental materials goal with large but indirect benefit. Honest limit: tasks must produce checkable, falsifiable outputs (a computed candidate with stated stability and Tc evidence, or a replication protocol); another unreplicated claim is not a result, and running published Tc regressors is a known baseline.
